description: This file defines a culture information object for the 'sms-FI' locale in the DateJS library, including date and time formats, month/day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and various date manipulation functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of a Date object to zero, effectively clearing the time part.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this Date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns timezone name based on offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns timezone offset for a given timezone name.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object.

methods.name: parseExact
methods.description: Parses a date string using an exact format.
